_note: Phase 392 plan 06 (F6 bypass 5, D-08). The closed class table of every Theo tool name the Part 8 PreToolUse hook can see. Read by lib/core/part8-egress-guard.cjs (_theoToolClass) by the part of the tool name after the last double underscore. content = generic handles only, scanned by the typed arm or the generic content arm; operational = room content by design (the absorbed mindrian-os surface), allowed with class operational_tool and not scanned; auth = an auth-only tool, allowed with class auth_tool and not scanned. A name absent from this table resolves to default_class (content) and is scanned. The six brain_* names are content on every server. Tool names only; no room content.
